verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Lorikeet connects to knowledge bases/ticketing systems and can 'audit' knowledge bases for gaps, but there is no mention of automatic scheduled re-syncing or event-driven re-ingestion when source content changes — ingestion appears to be a one-time 'connect... to ingest data' action. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled sync jobs, webhook/change-triggered re-ingestion, or any freshness/staleness detection mechanism.
